title: NeuroMAS: Multi-Agent Systems as Neural Networks with Joint Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2605.16757v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multi-agent language systems are often built as hand-designed workflows, where agents are assigned semantic roles and communication protocols are specified in advance. We propose NeuroMAS, a method that first treats a multi-agent language system as a trainable and scalable neural-network-like architecture with LLM agents as nodes and intermediate textual signals as edges. In NeuroMAS, agent nodes are role-free but structure-aware: the topology only determines how information can flow in general, while reinforcement learning training determines how nodes communicate, specialize, and coordinate. This formulation shifts multi-agent design from workflow engineering toward architecture design, where depth, width, connectivity, and growth protocol become scalable sources of capability. translated_title: NeuroMAS：将多智能体系统视为神经网络并结合联合强化学习
translated_abstract: 多智能体语言系统通常被构建为手工设计的工作流，其中智能体被预先分配语义角色，通信协议也事先指定。我们提出 NeuroMAS，这是一种首次将多智能体语言系统视为可训练、可扩展的类神经网络架构的方法，其中 LLM 智能体作为节点，中间文本信号作为边。在 NeuroMAS 中，智能体节点是角色无关但结构感知的：拓扑结构仅决定信息大体上如何流动，而强化学习训练决定节点如何通信、专门化与协调。这一表述将多智能体设计从工作流工程转向架构设计，使深度、宽度、连接性和增长协议成为可扩展的能力来源。此外，我们从理论上说明了当任务可进行层次化分解时，为什么这种模块化的文本计算更具参数效率。
tldr: 该论文提出 NeuroMAS，将多智能体语言系统视为以 LLM 智能体为节点、文本信号为边的可训练类神经网络架构，通过强化学习让节点自主学会通信、分工与协调，从而将多智能体设计从手工工作流工程转变为可扩展的架构设计。
en_tdlr: NeuroMAS reformulates multi-agent language systems as trainable, neural-network-like architectures—with LLM agents as nodes and textual signals as edges—where joint reinforcement learning learns communication, specialization, and coordination, shifting multi-agent design from hand-crafted workflow engineering to scalable architecture design.
